command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/setup-lvm-loops.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
for img in /var/lib/lvm-backing/*.img; do
    [ -e "$img" ] || continue
    if ! losetup -j "$img" | grep -q .; then
        losetup -f "$img"
    fi
done
udevadm settle
vgchange -ay vgdata || true
EOF
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/setup-lvm-loops.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/setup-lvm-loops.sh
